#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install host lifecycle binaries, the storage daemon and the cell spec.
# Preserve Android images and Wayland; use services for lifecycle transitions.
set -euo pipefail
stage="${1:?staging directory required}"
boot_id="${2:?verified boot identity required}"
test "$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)" = "$boot_id"
cd "$stage"
sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
test "$(uname -m)" = aarch64
test "$(tr '\000' '\n' </proc/device-tree/compatible | head -n1)" = oneplus,aston
test "$(id -u logix)" = 1001
# This mode must not accidentally replace local Android/graphics overrides.
shared="$(python3 - <<'PY'
import json
with open('/etc/droidloom/cell.json') as source:
    current = json.load(source)
with open('cell.json') as source:
    candidate = json.load(source)
shared = candidate.pop('shared_storage_directories', [])
current.pop('shared_storage_directories', None)
for spec in (current, candidate):
    spec['android_file_overrides'] = [entry for entry in spec['android_file_overrides']
        if entry != {'source': '/usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold', 'target': '/system/bin/vold'}]
if current != candidate:
    raise SystemExit('refusing to replace unrelated cell configuration')
print(len(shared))
PY
)"
if [[ "$shared" != 0 ]]; then
    test -c /dev/fuse
    grep -qw fuse /proc/filesystems
    unshare --user --map-users 1001:1023:1 --map-groups 1001:1023:1 true
    install -d -m 2770 -o 1001 -g 1001 /var/lib/droidloom/users/1001/shared-probe
fi
backup="$(mktemp -d "$stage/backup.XXXXXXXX")"
cp -a /usr/bin/droidloomd /usr/bin/droidloomctl /usr/bin/droidloom-supervisor /etc/droidloom/cell.json "$backup/"
if [[ -e /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold ]]; then
    cp -a /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold "$backup/vold"
fi
user_service() {
    runuser -u logix -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 \
        DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus systemctl --user "$@"
}
rollback() {
    trap - ERR
    systemctl stop droidloomd.service || true
    for binary in droidloomd droidloomctl droidloom-supervisor; do
        install -m 0755 "$backup/$binary" "/usr/bin/$binary"
    done
    install -m 0644 "$backup/cell.json" /etc/droidloom/cell.json
    if [[ -e "$backup/vold" ]]; then
        install -m 0755 "$backup/vold" /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold
    fi
    systemctl start droidloomd.service
    user_service start droidloom.service
    echo "supervisor update failed; restored $backup" >&2
    exit 1
}
trap rollback ERR
install -D -m 0755 vold /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold.new
mv -f /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold.new /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold
./droidloom-supervisor development-validate --spec "$stage/cell.json"
user_service stop droidloom.service
systemctl stop droidloomd.service
for binary in droidloomd droidloomctl droidloom-supervisor; do
    install -m 0755 "$stage/$binary" "/usr/bin/$binary"
done
install -m 0644 cell.json /etc/droidloom/cell.json
systemctl start droidloomd.service
user_service start droidloom.service
droidloomctl --json status
trap - ERR
printf 'Installed supervisor update; previous files preserved in %s\n' "$backup"

[Unit]
Description=Droidloom Android cell lifecycle daemon
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/droidloomd
TimeoutStopSec=20s
KillMode=mixed
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=1s
RuntimeDirectory=droidloom
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

[Unit]
Description=Droidloom native application catalog
PartOf=droidloom.service
After=droidloom.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/droidloom/cell.json

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/droidloom-applications
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

payload="${1:?payload directory is required}"
artifact_id="${2:?artifact identity is required}"
host_uid="${3:?host UID is required}"
host_user="${4:?host user is required}"

startup="${5:-manual}"
case "$startup" in manual|auto) ;; *) echo "startup must be manual or auto" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac

case "$artifact_id" in
    (*[!0-9a-f]*|'') echo "invalid artifact identity: $artifact_id" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
case "$host_uid" in
    (*[!0-9]*|'') echo "invalid host UID: $host_uid" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
case "$host_user" in
    (*[!a-zA-Z0-9_-]*|'') echo "invalid host user: $host_user" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac
[[ "$(id -u "$host_user")" == "$host_uid" ]] || {
    echo "host user $host_user does not own UID $host_uid" >&2
    exit 2
}

for required in \
    "$payload/usr/bin/droidloomd" \
    "$payload/usr/bin/droidloomctl" \
    "$payload/usr/bin/droidloom-applications" \
    "$payload/usr/bin/droidloom-supervisor" \
    "$payload/usr/bin/droidloom-wayland" \
    "$payload/usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom-applications.service" \
    "$payload/usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom.service" \
    "$payload/usr/lib/systemd/system/droidloomd.service" \
    "$payload/usr/lib/environment.d/60-droidloom.conf" \
    "$payload/usr/lib/droidloom/runtime/bin/droidloom-android-init" \
    "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/images/images/system.img" \
    "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/images/images/system_ext.img" \
    "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/images/images/product.img" \
    "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/images/images/vendor.raw.img" \
    "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data/data.img" \
    "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data/metadata.img" \
    "$payload/etc/droidloom/cell.json"; do
    [[ -f "$required" ]] || {
        echo "incomplete Droidloom payload: $required" >&2
        exit 2
    }
done

# Validate every declared runtime input before changing the installed runtime.
python3 - "$payload" "$host_uid" <<'PYCODE'
import json, pathlib, sys, zipfile
root = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
spec = json.loads((root / 'etc/droidloom/cell.json').read_text())
catalog = root / 'usr/lib/droidloom/runtime/framework/droidloom-input-bridge.jar'
with zipfile.ZipFile(catalog) as jar:
    dex = b''.join(jar.read(name) for name in jar.namelist() if name.endswith('.dex'))
if b'Lcom/android/droidloom/catalog/ApplicationCatalog;' not in dex:
    raise SystemExit('payload is missing the Android application catalog class')
if spec['host_uid'] != int(sys.argv[2]):
    raise SystemExit('payload cell owner does not match installation user')
paths = [entry['source'] for entry in spec.get('android_file_overrides', [])]
paths += [entry['source'] for entry in spec.get('android_runtime_directories', [])]
if spec.get('android_init'):
    paths.append(spec['android_init'])
for source in paths:
    source = source.replace('/usr/lib/droidloom/current/', '/usr/lib/droidloom/runtime/')
    path = root / source.lstrip('/')
    if not path.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f'incomplete runtime input: {path}')
PYCODE

# Mandatory before stopping any service or writing any installed file.
python3 "$(dirname -- "$0")/verify-bundle" verify "$payload"

if [[ -S "/run/user/$host_uid/bus" ]]; then
    runuser -u "$host_user" -- env XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$host_uid" \
        DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/$host_uid/bus" \
        systemctl --user stop droidloom.service || true
fi
if systemctl is-active --quiet droidloomd.service; then
    systemctl stop droidloomd.service
fi

runtime_final="/usr/lib/droidloom/artifacts/$artifact_id"
runtime_incoming="/usr/lib/droidloom/artifacts/.incoming-$artifact_id"
images_final="/var/lib/droidloom/images/$artifact_id"
images_incoming="/var/lib/droidloom/images/.incoming-$artifact_id"
# Host-only upgrades reuse the byte-identical immutable Android image set.
image_link="$artifact_id"
if [[ -d /var/lib/droidloom/images/current ]] && \
    diff -qr "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/images" /var/lib/droidloom/images/current >/dev/null; then
    images_final="$(readlink -f /var/lib/droidloom/images/current)"
    image_link="$(basename "$images_final")"
fi

install -d -m 0755 /usr/lib/droidloom/artifacts /usr/lib/droidloom/lib
if [[ -f "$payload/usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold" ]]; then
    install -D -m 0755 "$payload/usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold" /usr/lib/droidloom/storage/vold
fi
install -d -m 0755 /var/lib/droidloom/images "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid"
install -d -m 0700 "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data"
host_gid="$(id -g "$host_user")"
install -d -m 2770 -o "$host_uid" -g "$host_gid" \
    "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/shared-probe"

if [[ ! -d "$runtime_final" ]]; then
    rm -rf -- "$runtime_incoming"
    cp -a -- "$payload/usr/lib/droidloom/runtime" "$runtime_incoming"
    chown -R root:root "$runtime_incoming"
    mv -T -- "$runtime_incoming" "$runtime_final"
fi
if [[ ! -d "$images_final" ]]; then
    rm -rf -- "$images_incoming"
    cp -a -- "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/images" "$images_incoming"
    chown -R root:root "$images_incoming"
    mv -T -- "$images_incoming" "$images_final"
fi

if [[ ! -e "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data/data.img" ]]; then
    cp -a -- "$payload/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data/." \
        "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data/"
fi
chown -R root:root "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data"
chmod 0700 "/var/lib/droidloom/users/$host_uid/data"

for pending_link in \
    /usr/lib/droidloom/.current-new \
    /var/lib/droidloom/images/.current-new; do
    if [[ -e "$pending_link" && ! -L "$pending_link" ]]; then
        echo "refusing non-symlink activation path: $pending_link" >&2
        exit 2
    fi
    rm -f -- "$pending_link"
done
ln -s -- "artifacts/$artifact_id" /usr/lib/droidloom/.current-new
mv -Tf -- /usr/lib/droidloom/.current-new /usr/lib/droidloom/current
ln -s -- "$image_link" /var/lib/droidloom/images/.current-new
mv -Tf -- /var/lib/droidloom/images/.current-new /var/lib/droidloom/images/current

for binary in droidloomd droidloomctl droidloom-applications droidloom-supervisor droidloom-wayland; do
    install -m 0755 "$payload/usr/bin/$binary" "/usr/bin/$binary"
done
install -D -m 0644 "$payload/etc/droidloom/cell.json" /etc/droidloom/cell.json
install -D -m 0644 "$payload/usr/lib/systemd/system/droidloomd.service" \
    /usr/lib/systemd/system/droidloomd.service
install -D -m 0644 "$payload/usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom.service" \
    /usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom.service
install -D -m 0644 "$payload/usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom-applications.service" \
    /usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom-applications.service
install -D -m 0644 "$payload/usr/lib/environment.d/60-droidloom.conf" \
    /usr/lib/environment.d/60-droidloom.conf

# Remove Droidloom's obsolete compositor-plugin integration. A running
# compositor is deliberately left alone; this takes effect at its next normal
# session start while the new presenter can connect as an ordinary client now.
rm -f -- \
    /usr/lib/droidloom/lib/libdroidloom_denial_plugin.so \
    /usr/lib/droidloom/libdroidloom_denial_plugin.so \
    /usr/lib/systemd/user/droidloom-wayland.service \
    /etc/systemd/system/denial.service.d/50-droidloom-native-app-plugin.conf

systemctl daemon-reload
# Authorize only the configured local user and this exact lifecycle unit.
install -d -m 0755 /etc/polkit-1/rules.d
cat > /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/49-droidloom.rules <<EOF
polkit.addRule(function(action, subject) {
    if (action.id === "org.freedesktop.systemd1.manage-units" &&
        subject.user === "$host_user" &&
        action.lookup("unit") === "droidloomd.service" &&
        ["start", "stop"].indexOf(action.lookup("verb")) !== -1) {
        return polkit.Result.YES;
    }
});
EOF
chmod 0644 /etc/polkit-1/rules.d/49-droidloom.rules
systemctl disable --now droidloomd.service
systemctl --global disable droidloom.service

if [[ -S "/run/user/$host_uid/bus" ]]; then
    runuser -u "$host_user" -- env \
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$host_uid" \
        DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/$host_uid/bus" \
        systemctl --user daemon-reload
    runuser -u "$host_user" -- env \
        XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$host_uid" \
        DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/$host_uid/bus" \
        systemctl --user disable --now droidloom.service
    if [[ "$startup" == auto ]]; then
        runuser -u "$host_user" -- env \
            XDG_RUNTIME_DIR="/run/user/$host_uid" \
            DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS="unix:path=/run/user/$host_uid/bus" \
            systemctl --user enable --now droidloom.service
    fi
fi

printf 'installed Droidloom artifact %s for %s (%s)\n' \
    "$artifact_id" "$host_user" "$host_uid"
